assertion: This year’s election is now the most expensive in U.S. history, with total spending projected to reach nearly $12 billion, according to OpenSecrets, a nonprofit group that tracks campaign financing.
independent_value: AdImpact projects $11.6B in AD spending (most expensive on record); $11.21B booked as of Oct 26. No OpenSecrets 2026 total found; OpenSecrets reported $16.7B for 2022 across federal and state races
reason: opensecrets.org returned 403; the ~$12B magnitude matches AdImpact ad spending, so attribution to OpenSecrets and 'total spending' is doubtful

assertion: Spending on congressional races this year has surpassed that of any other election in U.S. history, including campaigns for president.
independent_value: AdImpact: $11.6B 2026 cycle exceeds $11.2B 2024 presidential cycle (ad spending)

assertion: More than half a billion dollars has been spent on the U.S. Senate race in Texas alone.
independent_value: Al Jazeera: more than $534M on the Texas race

assertion: Republican-aligned groups are outspending Democratic-aligned groups by nearly $400 million.
reason: Fetched sources say Republicans out-raised and out-spent Democrats but give no $400M outside-spending gap; AdImpact ad totals differ by far less than that for ads

assertion: Elon Musk, has sent $445 million to Republican political action committees.
independent_value: Outlook India $445M+; Al Jazeera $446M; Reuters/NYT tally $366M (different scope/date)

assertion: Billionaire George Soros has donated about $100 million to PACs supporting Democratic candidates.
independent_value: Al Jazeera donor tracker: Soros about $102M to left-leaning candidates/groups

assertion: Musk has poured more than $150 million into PACs supporting Paxton.
independent_value: $158M to Senate Leadership Fund, transferred to a Texas PAC backing Paxton (Outlook India); Al Jazeera: more than $150M to boost Paxton; Reuters lists only $10M directly to Lone Star Liberty PAC

assertion: In direct fundraising by the candidates, Talarico has far outpaced Paxton. His campaign has raised $145 million from individual donors, compared with Paxton’s $22 million.
warehouse_value: Talarico total receipts $146.3M, individual $139.8M; Paxton total $22.3M, individual $21.0M (through 2026-10-14)
sql: SELECT candidate_name, total_receipts, total_individual_contributions FROM fec.candidate_summaries WHERE "year"='2026' AND office='S' AND state='TX' ORDER BY total_receipts DESC FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY

assertion: Democratic candidates are focusing more on smaller dollar donations … the Republican Party is really focusing on fewer donors, but donors that happen to have a lot more resources available to them to make donations.
speaker: David Miller
warehouse_value: Talarico unitemized (<=$200) $75.3M of $139.8M individual (54%); Paxton $6.1M of $21.0M (29%); Politico analysis via Al Jazeera says Republicans rely more on large donors
sql: SELECT candidate_name, individual_unitemized, total_individual_contributions FROM fec.candidate_summaries WHERE "year"='2026' AND office='S' AND state='TX' ORDER BY total_receipts DESC FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY
